card.engineering_obligation: The meaning of a journey's terminal assertion is typed data whose strength is derivable and gated — a major journey's test may not assert less than task closure.
card.solution_structure: A typed closure block on the journey entity: a sealed boolean algebra (AND/OR/NOT, deliberately non-temporal) over a reviewed library of leaf predicates preferring accessibility observables; flow-only leaves (navigated, 2xx) exist but cannot constitute a closure alone; a pure total derivation yields TASK_CLOSED / FLOW_ONLY / DISABLED; a gate makes a major journey deriving FLOW_ONLY a finding; forward-policing lints; audit-only-first landing while the backlog drains.
card.guarantee: A major journey's terminal assertion provably has the shape of task closure, and the same typed closure resolves through a second resolver (a headless canary probe) pre-promotion. Boundary: closes meaning, not robustness — deep-vs-shallow assertion stays human review.
card.semantic_level: terminal assertion ⊨ task outcome — the test's meaning held equal to the user's goal, with strength derived from the expression's shape.
card.forces_tradeoffs: The leaf library must extend by reviewed registry addition or it sprawls into bespoke predicates. A disabled closure must stay visible as DISABLED, not vanish into green. Audit-only-first is the honest landing for unmigrated journeys.
card.dependencies: user-journey-model (the carrier); the criticality axis to scope the gate; observable resolvers (a11y roles, HTTP status, file magic); drift-parity thinking applied to the terminal assertion; sibling journey-criticality-test-placement (picks up where its floor stops).
card.known_uses: DocAble's typed closure blocks on major journeys ('artifact rendered AND content inspectable AND no error-fallback' — the fixed form of a real one-hop-past production break); the strength gate; the canary closure-probe closing the configuration-only-break containment hole.
card.likely_parent_family: Model-derived assurance coverage (typed post-condition with derived strength)

card.failure_class: Substrate drift via hardcoded snapshots: a consumer pastes 'our packages are [A, B, C]' into a lint or test, the model changes, and the consumer keeps passing while reasoning about a stale world — the single most common drift recurrence vector, tempting at every consumer.
card.engineering_obligation: Consumers derive answers from the live model at use time — a copied-out value is banned; one authoritative answer, every consumer derives it, a model change updates all of them at once.
card.solution_structure: A consumption convention (read at run/lint-time, via the query surface for agents or direct import for tools) codified as a preference order (lint-reads-meta-file > codegen > hand-rolled copy), enforced by a forward-policing lint that fails a test embedding a snapshot of a queryable value, plus a rule that lints declare their scope against the component model rather than hardcoding it.
card.guarantee: No private copies on the policed paths; the consumer's answer is the model's answer. Boundary: the ban-lint must recognize what counts as a queryable value; slight per-consumer ceremony and load-time coupling.
card.semantic_level: consumer value → live model query — single source of truth; the copy relation banned.
card.forces_tradeoffs: A query call instead of a literal (the intended trade). The consumer now depends on the model loading when it runs. The ban-lint's accuracy bounds the guarantee.
card.dependencies: query-surface (the canonical read path); the models themselves; consumed by dynamic-context-injection, coherence-lints, doc-hygiene-lints, the reflection facets (policy by reference).
card.known_uses: DocAble's component registry + repo-query read at runtime by the lint fleet and dispatch; the snapshot-ban lint; the lint-scope-declares-against-the-model rule.
card.likely_parent_family: Read the model, don't copy it (canonical pattern)

models-bridge/system-models/model-derive.title: Model-derived test-obligation census (derive obligations, lint the gap)

card.failure_class: Coverage blind to what should exist: whole categories of obligation (an unfuzzed external seam, a failure edge with no injection test, an invariant with no checker) sit at zero behind a rising line-coverage percentage, because coverage's denominator is what you built, not what you owe — and every new seam silently adds an obligation nothing counts.
card.engineering_obligation: Derive the should-be-tested denominator from the models themselves and lint the gap to the tests that exist — an untested obligation is a named, listable finding whose set regrows with every model change.
card.solution_structure: Walk the structured models that declare a testable surface (seam registry, failure-edge model, invariant list) to compute obligation sets; join each obligation against the test corpus (by convention, tag, or registry); an obligation with no matching test is a finding attributable to the model element that generated it; one census genre reused across obligation kinds.
card.guarantee: An entire untested category is a listable finding set, and a newly-added surface reopens the gap until a test closes it. Boundary: measures obligation coverage, not test quality — a matched weak test counts as covered; the obligation↔test join must track naming/tagging or it reports false gaps or false safety.
card.semantic_level: model-declared surface → owed test — the obligation relation, with the denominator drawn from the model rather than the code.
card.forces_tradeoffs: The matching rule is load-bearing maintenance. Quality judgment is delegated to other mechanisms. The census is only as complete as the models that declare surfaces.
card.dependencies: Models declaring testable surfaces (executable-source-of-truth); a matchable test corpus; a gate treating unmet obligations as findings; fuzz-campaigns discharge the fuzz obligations; generalizes coverage-model-mapping across obligation kinds; sibling journey-task-closure.
card.known_uses: DocAble's fuzz-target census (should-be-fuzzed from the seam model); the error-path injection census (should-have-injection from the failure-edge model); the invariant-checker census.
card.likely_parent_family: Model-derived assurance coverage

card.failure_class: A model nothing depends on: if models only describe, nothing breaks when they're wrong, so nothing keeps them right; and separately, a hand-edit to a generated artifact is silently lost on the next regen.
card.engineering_obligation: The model must drive the system, not describe it — real artifacts derived from the model, provenance-marked so hand-edits and staleness are mechanically caught.
card.solution_structure: A family of generators reading the models and emitting real artifacts (network policy, service catalog, env wiring, API docs, wire-contract types, docker, human-readable diagrams), each output carrying a provenance header (emitter + regen path) re-emitted every run, enforced by a provenance lint plus a freshness/drift lint.
card.guarantee: One authoritative source per generated artifact class: change the artifact by changing the model; a hand-edit or stale artifact fails the build. Boundary: only the generated classes — everything else needs parity gates instead.
card.semantic_level: artifact = f(model) — the derivation relation, provenance-marked, with hand-edit detection.
card.forces_tradeoffs: A generator per artifact class to author and keep current with the model schema. Generated files must never be hand-edited (a real constraint). Regen discipline on every model change (the freshness lint catches misses).
card.dependencies: Models rich enough to generate from (service-flow, domain-registries, deployment-topology); the provenance-header lint (doc-hygiene kin); cross-target kin: product mutator-stamps ('the tool records what it produced').
card.known_uses: DocAble's NetworkPolicy, service-catalog, env, web-API-entity, public-API-doc, competitor-catalog, wire-contract, and docker generators; the Mermaid model-visualization generator (even the picture a human reads can't drift).
card.likely_parent_family: Executable source of truth (the generation face)

card.failure_class: Findings graded uniformly wrong: an all-or-nothing gate blocks a one-file commit on a pre-existing finding three subsystems away (agents learn to bypass, the gate stops protecting), or each lint re-implements its own relevance scoping and the logic drifts N ways.
card.engineering_obligation: A finding's severity is a function of the finding AND the change, computed by one central authority against a structured model at check time — the relevance decision owned once, never re-implemented per lint.
card.solution_structure: Lints emit structured findings (site, causing input, machine-readable kind, fix-guidance) and stop deciding relevance; the commit gate loads the component model live in-process and runs one grader over every finding: HARD (site or causing input in the changed set — block, with rendered fix-guidance), SOFT (same component — warn), SILENT (elsewhere — defer to the downstream no-baseline backstop); un-gradable findings fail closed to HARD; the grade is additive-restrictive (can relax, cannot fabricate a block).
card.guarantee: One grading rule holds for every finding and every future lint that emits the contract, with a fail-safe worst case (a grader bug can let a finding slip to the backstop, never invent a spurious block). Boundary: SILENT means deferred, not unchecked — the backstop is required.
card.semantic_level: finding × change → severity via model distance — enforcement relevance as a computed relation over the component model, read at check time.
card.forces_tradeoffs: Centralizing the join gives one grader one blast radius (traded against N drifting private copies). SOFT debt accumulates until a hygiene pass. Whole-tree lint runs cost more per governed commit (a cost-threshold routes expensive lints to self-scoped paths). The structured-finding contract becomes load-bearing.
card.dependencies: component-zone-model (read live at check time — the sharpest model-consumed-to-run-a-mechanism instance); the structured-finding emission contract (pre-existing in the instance); the pre-commit hook as host; meta-model-consumption; a downstream no-baseline gate.
card.known_uses: DocAble's governed-doc pre-commit hook grading whole-tree doc-staleness and index-comprehensiveness findings against the component-and-zone model — fixing the recurring blocked-by-unrelated-stale-findings incident; HARD-by-causation for a commit adding an unindexed doc (site untouched, causing input in the change).
card.likely_parent_family: Model-computed enforcement policy (a model dogfooded to grade a gate) — near the drift/parity + meta-consumption cluster

card.failure_class: Ad-hoc, error-prone model access: left to cat/grep the model files, agents and one-off tools re-implement loading and traversal, get the dialect subtly wrong, and produce brittle one-offs — defeating the queryable map's purpose.
card.engineering_obligation: Provide one canonical, self-describing read API over the models so bounded agents consume structure, not prose, and the loading dialect is documented once.
card.solution_structure: A CLI with ~15 deterministic subcommands and a stable --json contract, plus a self-describing models meta-command; co-located with the models so its loader is the canonical load example; atomic writes where relevant.
card.guarantee: Deterministic structured output on the canonical path. Boundary: soft — the canonical convenience, not a lint-banned monopoly; direct import remains legitimate for Python tools.
card.semantic_level: consumer → model read path — the access relation canonicalized (one documented dialect instead of N re-derivations).
card.forces_tradeoffs: Not the sole path, by design. A subcommand surface that grows with every model added.
card.dependencies: The models loading cleanly (executable-source-of-truth); meta-model-consumption as the discipline it serves; ridden by the traceability graph, the blast-radius query, and the coverage roll-ups.
card.known_uses: DocAble's repo-query CLI (component / service-flow / frontend-flow / design / callers / xrefs / epic / task / web-api / config, --json); the repo-query orchestrator skill.
card.likely_parent_family: Executable source of truth (the agent-facing read face)

card.failure_class: Silent traceability rot: the cross-references an agent walks between abstraction levels (model → enforcing lint → code root → proof → registry) go stale on every refactor — the model still looks authoritative while pointing at a ghost, and the blow-up lands days later in a downstream gate; plus the pointer-drift class (a built replacement never repointed-to, so the system defaults to the retired implementation).
card.engineering_obligation: Every cross-layer join is a typed, derived edge re-provable against live reality — derived edges defend, snapshotted ones drift; liveness must be a property of the representation (resolution IS the read), not a sync process running beside a snapshot.
card.solution_structure: A typed graph: TraceEdges over a closed kind vocabulary (governs / enforced-by / verified-by / derived-from / points-at) with a sanctioned kind-pair table and a non-optional derivation per edge, each terminating on a SymbolAnchor (path, symbol, resolver — never a line number; resolver chosen by file type, textual fallback only as a declared weak edge); a meta-lint re-derives every edge at DoD/audit cadence (cost-bound); an active-implementation registry + pointer-agreement lint for the points-at class; bidirectional traversal doubles as the agent's externalized mental model; an unresolvable anchor routes as an abstraction-completeness finding (the code lacks the seam), not an error.
card.guarantee: A broken join reddens at scan time, and an anchor that resolves means both the model's claim is currently true and the agent's traversal is a current slice. Boundary: resolution catches deletion, not demotion (a symbol that exists but no longer plays the claimed role resolves green — the keyword companion covers role currency); cadence, not per-commit.
card.semantic_level: model element ⟷ its enforcing/verifying/governed artifacts — the join web between abstraction levels, held by derivation rather than storage.
card.forces_tradeoffs: Symbol resolution is expensive — the cadence follows the cost. Weak-prover fallbacks are standing flagged debt. The closed edge vocabulary must evolve honestly (no untyped string edges).
card.dependencies: Existing static symbol resolvers (the graph composes them); structured models with addressable elements; in-situ anchor homes (typed fields, structured comment trailers); query-surface for bidirectional walks; generalizes drift-parity-gates beyond the single model↔code edge kind.
card.known_uses: DocAble's trace graph: a twelve-model fan-out classifying ~600 anchors caught ~14 genuine drifts for which NO existing lint fired (near-1 signal-to-noise, zero false positives); the clean-vs-drifted split evidence (anchor-linted models drifted zero; unlinted registries carried the drift); the active-implementation registry seeded by a prod-blocking unwired-replacement incident; the proof-as-anchor trajectory (a verified-by edge targeting a checker run, enabling triggered re-verification).
card.likely_parent_family: Drift/parity gate (generalized: the derived traceability graph over the whole join web) — possibly its own canonical pattern
card.note: Strong canonical-pattern candidate in its own right ('Derived Traceability'); the entry's evidence discipline (designed from observed drift, validated on an independent drift set) is unusually strong.
